narrative: The letter, open. The leaf on the desk, seal-wax cracked beside it, dust on the outer wrapper. The writing is a clear unlearned hand. No second sheet. The letter, open. The foot of the same leaf. The lines are even. Nothing is added in his hand on this page.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read it and did not answer it tonight.

entities.name: Anne's letter
entities.context: Shown on letter in Her hand, the second time
